text: Quality alert: Atlas says the heavy-duty wiring harness sent to the Texas plant had a moisture contamination. Anything built Monday Feb 22 through Wednesday Feb 24 is suspect.

incidents.span: Texas heavy-duty wiring harness Atlas   Monday Feb 22 Wednesday Feb 24

summary: E-14 is Quality hold. 1 lot(s) held, 36 dealer stop-sale call(s), 94 owner(s) contacted.
reasoning: Walked LOT-0017 → production orders of models that use HARN-B → vehicles built at P_TX from 2027-02-22 through 2027-02-24. 180 vehicles: 86 unsold, 94 owners. Rule 6. Guardrail: only orders, vehicles, dealers, and customers reached by the walk are touched. Shared slots and loaner pools are one board for the whole event, so a compound message cannot double-book them.

handoffs.did: Split the message into 1 incident(s) and dispatched specialists.
